hillburrow/doctor-drunk-healed.answer-leave: It was nothing. I'll let you take it from here.
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-healed.answer-secret: A good doctor never reveals her sources.
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-healed.answer-wastes: Picked it up in the wastes, one patient at a time.
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-healed.entry:
You step back from the patient. He's breathing slowly but steadily, and a bit of color is coming back to his face. The doctor stares at your work, mouth half open.

I… that was… I've been doing this for years and I've never seen anypony close an internal wound that clean. Where in Equestria did you learn techniques like these ?
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-healed.secret-reaction: That… sounds like the exact opposite of what a good doctor would do. Keep your secrets, then. You've still got my gratitude, and I don't give it out lightly.
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-healed.wastes-reaction: That's a hell of a school. If you ever feel like sharing what you know, my door is open. Thank you. Truly.
